grammar_title: 不定式复习(Review of the Infinitive: to do)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 5 Review of the Infinitive(不定式作目的状语/定语/主宾表;作宾语补足语与疑问词+to do;不定式的时态语态与习语)。句子地道、求职/简历/面试/职业规划主题,答案唯一(只有正确不定式形式成立)。

points.point: 不定式作目的状语 / 后置定语 / 主语·宾语·表语
points.overview: want/decide/hope/plan/wish/aim to do 作宾语;the best way / the first person 后置定语用 to do;表目的用 to do;My goal/dream is to do 作表语。

points.point: 不定式作宾语补足语 + 疑问词 + to do
points.overview: ask/advise/encourage/tell/want sb to do(宾补);疑问词 how/what/where/whether + to do 构成不定式短语作宾语等。

points.point: 不定式的时态语态与习语
points.overview: 被动 to be done;完成 to have done;too ... to;enough to;in order to / so as to 表目的。

questions.stem: I am writing this letter ____ for the position of camp helper.
questions.explanation: 表目的用不定式 to apply(为了申请)。

questions.stem: She decided ____ a career test before choosing a university major.
questions.explanation: decide to do sth,接不定式作宾语。

questions.stem: My goal is ____ a job that I am truly passionate about.
questions.explanation: be 后接不定式 to land 作表语。

questions.stem: The best way ____ for an interview is to research the company first.
questions.explanation: the way 后用不定式作后置定语(the way to do)。

questions.stem: He hopes ____ his own company after graduating from college.
questions.explanation: hope to do sth。

questions.stem: We are looking for keen young people ____ us at the summer camp.
questions.explanation: people 后用不定式作后置定语,含将来/目的意味。

questions.stem: Kelly plans ____ a cover letter together with her CV.
questions.explanation: plan to do sth。

questions.stem: ____ a good career, you first need to know what you are passionate about.
questions.explanation: 句首不定式作目的状语(为了建立)。

questions.stem: Her dream is ____ a graphic designer at a famous studio.
questions.explanation: be 后接不定式 to become 作表语。

questions.stem: The first thing ____ in your career plan is your long-term goal.
questions.explanation: the first thing 后用不定式作后置定语。

questions.stem: I wish ____ exchange students a warm welcome to our country.
questions.explanation: wish to do sth。

questions.stem: She went to the careers fair ____ more about different jobs.
questions.explanation: 表目的用不定式 to learn。

questions.stem: ____ in this field, you must keep developing your skills every year.
questions.explanation: 句首不定式作目的状语(为了成功)。

questions.stem: He aims ____ a lawyer because he cares about fairness and justice.
questions.explanation: aim to do sth。

questions.stem: The next step ____ is to tailor your CV to each job you want.
questions.explanation: the step 后用不定式作后置定语(the step to take)。

questions.stem: Many students choose ____ a foreign language to improve their job chances.
questions.explanation: choose to do sth。

questions.stem: Our plan is ____ a team of enthusiastic helpers for next summer.
questions.explanation: be 后接不定式 to build 作表语。

questions.stem: She volunteered at a library ____ the children's section in order.
questions.explanation: 表目的用不定式 to put(为了整理)。

questions.stem: The ability ____ priorities is important for any team leader.
questions.explanation: the ability to do sth,不定式作后置定语。

questions.stem: He wants ____ his life to research, just as Zhong Yang did.
questions.explanation: want to do sth。

questions.stem: The teacher advised us ____ a clear career plan as early as possible.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do sth,不定式作宾语补足语。

questions.stem: His parents encouraged him ____ a major that suited his interests.
questions.explanation: encourage sb to do sth。

questions.stem: I am not sure ____ to write in the opening line of my cover letter.
questions.explanation: what + to do 构成不定式短语(写什么)。

questions.stem: The interviewer asked her ____ about her previous work experience.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do sth。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ____ to apply for this summer camp position?
questions.explanation: how + to do(怎样申请)。

questions.stem: Her mentor told her ____ confident during the whole interview.
questions.explanation: tell sb to do sth。

questions.stem: I haven't decided ____ to put first on my list of dream careers.
questions.explanation: which (job) + to do(把哪份工作放第一)。

questions.stem: The camp council wants every helper ____ guests to the reception area.
questions.explanation: want sb to do sth。

questions.stem: She showed the new helpers ____ to keep the parking area clean.
questions.explanation: how + to do(怎样保持……整洁)。

questions.stem: My careers teacher expects each of us ____ a short speech about our goals.
questions.explanation: expect sb to do sth。

questions.stem: He didn't know ____ to send his CV, on paper or by email.
questions.explanation: whether + to do(是否……,选哪种方式)。

questions.stem: The employer asked the applicants ____ their best qualities in the letter.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do sth。

questions.stem: Please tell me ____ to find reliable information about different careers.
questions.explanation: where + to do(在哪里找到)。

questions.stem: Our coach taught us ____ as a team and decide on priorities together.
questions.explanation: teach sb to do sth。

questions.stem: She still wonders ____ to study at home or at a vocational school.
questions.explanation: whether + to do(是否……)。

questions.stem: The advisor warned him not ____ only money when choosing a career.
questions.explanation: warn sb (not) to do sth。

questions.stem: Can you advise me ____ to highlight at the top of my résumé?
questions.explanation: what + to do(突出什么)。

questions.stem: The manager requires every applicant ____ a cover letter with the CV.
questions.explanation: require sb to do sth。

questions.stem: I'd like someone experienced ____ me how to behave in an interview.
questions.explanation: would like sb to do sth。

questions.stem: He hasn't worked out ____ to begin his speech about his future career.
questions.explanation: how + to do(怎样开始)。

questions.stem: Your CV should be tailored to each job ____ a strong impression.
questions.explanation: 表目的用主动不定式 to make(为了留下印象);主语是 CV 但动作由你完成,主动。

questions.stem: This kind of attention to detail needs ____ before you send the letter.
questions.explanation: 需要被付出 → 被动不定式 to be paid。

questions.stem: She was too nervous ____ clearly in her very first job interview.
questions.explanation: too ... to do(太紧张以致说不清)。

questions.stem: He seems ____ a lot about careers before he gave us this advice.
questions.explanation: 动作先于谓语 → 完成不定式 to have read。

questions.stem: I am organised enough ____ several tasks at the camp at the same time.
questions.explanation: adj. + enough + to do(足够……以做……)。

questions.stem: The applicants worked hard ____ a good cover letter and CV.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的。

questions.stem: Every CV must ____ to match the careers in your plan.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接 be done 被动(简历被调整)。

questions.stem: She studied calligraphy for years ____ teach it to camp visitors one day.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的。

questions.stem: He is glad ____ for the helper position last summer.
questions.explanation: 动作已发生且被动 → 完成被动不定式 to have been chosen。

questions.stem: The interview questions were not difficult ____ once she relaxed.
questions.explanation: 形容词后用主动不定式 to answer(问题易于回答)。

questions.stem: Many skills still need ____ before he is ready for that career.
questions.explanation: 技能需要被学会 → 被动不定式 to be learned。

questions.stem: The young photographer was patient enough ____ for hours in the grass.
questions.explanation: adj. + enough + to do。

questions.stem: She arrived early ____ avoid being late for the important interview.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的。

questions.stem: He was too inexperienced ____ that senior position straight away.
questions.explanation: too ... to do(太缺经验以致得不到)。

questions.stem: All these documents ought ____ before the application deadline.
questions.explanation: ought to + be done 被动(文件被提交)。

questions.stem: She appears ____ a great deal of volunteer work during high school.
questions.explanation: 动作先于现在 → 完成不定式 to have done。

questions.stem: He spoke slowly ____ that the interviewers could follow him easily.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的。

questions.stem: Such a competitive job is hard ____ without solid experience.
questions.explanation: 形容词后用主动不定式 to get(此类工作难得到)。

questions.stem: Your achievements deserve ____ clearly on the first page of the CV.
questions.explanation: 成就值得被列出 → 被动不定式 to be listed。

questions.stem: The candidate was confident enough ____ in front of the whole panel.
questions.explanation: adj. + enough + to do。
